One reason is that in a world of increasing temporal and spiritual turbulence, true sources of comfort will become more scarce. quote.speaker: Elder Matthew J. Eyring

bom.text: Thus we may see that the Lord is merciful unto all who will, in the sincerity of their hearts, call upon his holy name.

quote.text: Lifelong disciples of Jesus Christ best reflect the Savior’s teaching and direction when they joyfully live lives of integrity and virtue. quote.text: The Savior sees our divine potential and, as the scriptures teach, “calleth those things which be not as though they were.” He sees not only who we are but who we can become. Through His atoning sacrifice, He makes that divine potential possible for all of us.

And they shall perish. But to be learned is good if they hearken unto the counsels of God.
